descriptive_title: Grade 1 Mathematics: Algebra — Identifying Change vs Constant Quantities, Testing Equivalence, and Using Equivalent Relationships for Numbers to 50 (C2.1–C2.3)
short_description: A 5-day Ontario Grade-1 unit on Algebra (C2.1-C2.3) framed around 'Balance Scale Stories' — Bella the Balance Beam Scientist and Bobby her Balance Beam Buddy. Change-vs-constant, equality testing, and equivalent expressions all in one focused week.
long_description: Children spend a focused week as Junior Balance Beam Scientists. Day 1 introduces quantities that change vs stay the same (C2.1). Day 2 introduces the balance scale as the equality model (C2.2). Day 3 tackles missing-number puzzles. Day 4 hunts for equivalent expressions to numbers up to 50 (C2.3). Day 5 closes with child-created balance stories. Each lesson includes a 4000+ char expanded_walkthrough covering misconceptions and recovery moves: snapshot vs trend, operator misconception of =, operator-as-instruction (4+?=7 ≠ 11), variety of equivalence, story-without-structure.
what_is_included: 5 fully-scripted lesson plans with 50-minute durations and 250 minutes of total teaching time
5 student worksheets aligned to each lesson

10 printable teacher manipulatives plus 2 character puppets: classroom balance scale instructions, balance scale drawing mat, change-vs-constant cards (24), equivalence cards (30), two-colour counters label, missing-number puzzle cards (24), equivalent-target cards (12), balance story template, equal sign anchor chart, balance stories poster, plus stick-puppet variants of Bella and Bobby
1 end-of-unit reflection sheet with 5 self-assessment prompts
1 three-row summative rubric covering C2.1-C2.3 across 4 levels
1 summative-administration guide tying the rubric to Lesson 5 worksheet
Junior Balance Beam Scientist certificate (one per child)
Detailed expanded walkthroughs for every lesson
Differentiation tracks built into every lesson
target_buyer: Ontario Grade 1 teachers covering the C2.1-C2.3 cluster of the 2026 Grade 1 Math curriculum.
subject: Mathematics
pedagogical_approach: CRA progression. Real or cardboard balance scale anchors equivalence. Lesson 1 conceptualises change vs constant. Lesson 2 introduces the equality model. Lesson 3 extends to missing-number puzzles. Lesson 4 generates equivalent expressions. Lesson 5 closes with capstone storytelling. Differentiation is proactive.
